decision: Reject current coalescing prototype. Road speedup 1.043/0.962 misses prediction; work increases 69/81%, above the 20% limit. Mesh speedup 0.993/1.114 is source-dependent and does not reverse the one-node regression.
caveats: Matched road trace speedup is diagnostic only and differs from production outcomes.
Both jobs used the same physical nodes but different allocations/times; compare arms within each job.
Controller threshold-change count is an ordering-change counter, not a count of mathematically necessary SSSP rounds.
Controller progress classification excludes the initial observation and final termination round. An unchanged threshold is not an empty round; most such rounds still create or retire updates.
